text: dsh-plugins-market 是面向 DSH Web 的插件发现与安装面板，在 Plugins 设置区提供插件市场。它从 GitHub 的 dsh-plugin 主题收集仓库，过滤噪音，并展示精选标记、星数和兼容信息。用户可以按星数、近期趋势、创建或推送时间排序，也能按名称、描述和编程语言搜索筛选；选择插件后，市场会检查其 bundle 声明，再呈现安装确认。适合希望在 DSH Web 中浏览社区插件并从界面发起安装的用户。市场查询使用 GitHub 公开 API；无需额外用户密钥。

dsh-plugins-market adds plugin discovery to DSH Web settings. Browse GitHub plugin repositories, search and filter results, compare stars and updates, then start installation after a bundle check and confirmation. It uses public GitHub APIs.
想在 DSH Web 里直接浏览社区插件并找到合适的插件。
能不能按星数或最近涨星情况给 DSH 插件排序？
我想搜索插件名称或描述，再按编程语言筛选。
希望在 DSH 设置页面查看精选标记和插件仓库信息。
能在插件安装前确认它声明了 DSH bundle 吗？
How can I discover and install community plugins from DSH Web settings?
dsh-plugins-market 的功能「插件发现与过滤」：从 GitHub 的 dsh-plugin 主题整理插件列表，过滤非插件噪音，并提供关键词搜索和语言筛选。
dsh-plugins-market 的功能「排序和趋势」：在插件面板中按总星数、近期星数变化、创建时间或最近推送排序，并显示可用的星数变化信息。
dsh-plugins-market 的功能「精选与仓库信息」：插件卡片展示精选或官方标记、描述、语言、星数、更新时间和主题标签，帮助用户比较搜索结果。
dsh-plugins-market 的功能「安装插件」：用户选择 GitHub 插件后，市场检查 package.json 是否声明 DSH bundle，并在确认后通过本机 dsh CLI 发起 profile 安装。
想从 DSH 的插件设置页按更新时间找到新插件。
I want to browse, compare, and install DSH plugins without leaving the Web UI.

dsh-plugins-market README · What it does：- **Discovery**: crawls GitHub topic `dsh-plugin` (top ~500 repos by stars; rate-limit friendly pacing, first load ~30s, then 10-minute cache) and filters topic-squatting noise - **Trust signals**: badges for `精选` (human-curated) and community compatibility verdicts (`兼容` / `需适配` / `已删除` / `关注`) - **Ranking & filtering**: by total stars / recent surge / newest / last push (asc/desc toggle), instant search, language filter; cards show `★ N (+M)` daily star delta when snapshot data covers the repo - **Install funnel**: click Install → verify the repo declares `dsh.bundle.patch` in package.json (non-bundles are rejected) → show the exact command with an allowBuilds security warning → confirm → run `dsh plugin --profile

dsh-plugins-market README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Luaphes/dsh-plugins-market
```

Restart the Web UI afterwards; a "Discover plugins" tab appears under Settings → Plugins. Zero build step, no install scripts, no allowBuilds prompt.

Once published to npm: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugins-market`

dsh-plugins-market README · Architecture：- Host half: GitHub Search API crawl (rate-limit friendly, 10-minute in-memory cache), merges curated/compatibility source data, computes star deltas from daily snapshots, install verification & execution (approval-gated)
- Daily snapshots: the `star-snapshots.yml` GitHub Actions workflow records topic repo stars at 02:00 UTC into `snapshots/YYYY-MM-DD.json`; the market serves deltas computed from the two most recent snapshots
- Client half: registers the official `settings.plugins.tab` extension point, React card list
- Zero LLM, zero backend, zero user quota: rules + public APIs only

dsh-plugins-market README · Source credits：- Official discovery mechanism: GitHub topic [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
- `精选` marks: the catalog content of [@0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness](https://github.com/0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness)
- Compatibility verdicts: the daily radar table of [@AdamPlatin123/awesome-dsh-plugins](https://github.com/AdamPlatin123/awesome-dsh-plugins)

- [ ] npm publish + CI auto-release (Trusted Publishing)
